faqs.q: What is a 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded used for?
faqs.a: The 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded is a threaded pipe nipple cut from Sch 40 welded pipe, with an NPT male thread on both ends, used to join female-threaded fittings and valves or to make up short spool pieces. This listing holds 163 part numbers from 1/8" to 6".

faqs.q: How do I read part number IH-PF-N4W4-16-5.0 on the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded?
faqs.a: IH-PF-N4W4-16-5.0 is the 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded in 1" NPT at a length of 5.0 in. The base number IH-PF-N4W4 is followed by the size code 16 = 1" NPT, then the length in inches, so 0.75 gives 19 mm and 12.0 gives 304.8 mm.

faqs.q: What sizes does the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded come in?
faqs.a: The 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded is listed in 163 part numbers from 1/8" to 6", in several NPT sizes and several lengths per size. The shortest regular row, IH-PF-N4W4-02-0.75, is 19 mm long and the longest, IH-PF-N4W4-96-12.0, is 304.8 mm. Lengths outside the table are quoted on request.

faqs.q: How do I choose the right size of 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded?
faqs.a: Choose the 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded by NPT size, length and wall: size sets the thread, length sets the gap between the two female ports, and the schedule sets the wall. This listing is Sch 40 welded pipe. Measure from port face to port face, and allow for the thread that enters each port.

faqs.q: What is the working pressure of the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded?
faqs.a: The manufacturer publishes no pressure rating for the 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded, so we do not quote one. A nipple holds what its pipe schedule and thread allow, and the rating of the fittings it joins also limits the line. Send the working pressure and temperature and we will confirm it.

faqs.q: Should I choose 304 or 316 for the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded?
faqs.a: The 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded is made from 304 stainless steel (welded pipe). 304 suits fresh water, air and food service; 316 adds molybdenum and resists chlorides, so it is chosen for seawater, brine and many chemicals. The [316 version](/p/316-stainless-steel-npt-pipe-nipple-sch-40-welded) is listed separately.

faqs.q: Which standard does the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded follow, and can I get certificates?
faqs.a: The 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded is listed to ASME B1.20.1, which defines the NPT taper pipe thread on both ends. This listing holds no test certificate or declaration; if your job needs a material certificate, ask for it in the enquiry so it can be requested before supply.

faqs.q: What does the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded connect to?
faqs.a: The 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded screws into female NPT fittings and valves of the same thread size. Matching stainless threaded fittings are on our [150# threaded fittings shelf](/c/stainless-steel-150-threaded-pipe-fittings) and [3000# forged fittings shelf](/c/stainless-steel-3000-forged-threaded-fittings). faqs.q: How do I fit the 304 NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded without a thread leak?
faqs.a: Fit the 304 Stainless Steel NPT Pipe Nipple, Sch 40 Welded with sealant or tape on the male NPT threads, and tighten only until the joint is tight, because extra turns do not improve a taper-thread seal. Stainless threads can gall if made up dry, so use a stainless-grade sealant or lubricant.
